Got questions?
we've got answers

Everything you need to know about buying, selling and transferring domains on Nameshift. Still stuck? Get in touch.

Contact us
What services do you offer?

Nameshift is a marketplace to buy, sell and auction premium domains. Buyers browse and bid; sellers list single names or whole portfolios, all backed by buyer protection: the seller is only paid once the domain is yours.

How long does a domain transfer take?

You can normally use your purchased domain name within 24 hours but most domains transfer within a few hours once payment clears. Our team guides both sides through every step. However, we are dependent on how quickly the seller responds to our transfer instruction.

What kind of domains can I find?

Premium domain names across dozens of categories, including e-commerce, finance, real estate, crypto, AI, travel and more, all searchable in our extensive domain database.

How are my payments protected?

Every purchase runs through our secure payment process: the seller is only paid once the domain is confirmed in your name, and if the transfer can't be completed, you get your money back.

What does it cost to sell on Nameshift?

Buyers pay no fees. Sellers enjoy some of the lowest commissions in the market, with gTLDs at 6.5% and ccTLD commissions starting at 10% and dropping as low as 5.5% as your sales volume grows.

When will I get paid after selling my domain?

As soon as the domain is transferred, we offer the option to receive your funds directly into your bank account. Payouts are processed immediately, with the funds reaching your account as quickly as your bank can process the payment.
